subject: Food Science
title: Enemies of Freshness
description: A quick win: understand Enemies of Freshness.

hook.text: A fresh strawberry lasts 3 days on the counter. A freeze-dried one lasts 25 years. Preservation bends time.

buildup.text: Food spoils due to microbes, enzymes, oxygen, moisture, and light. Each one degrades food differently.

discovery.text: Enzymes inside the food itself cause browning and softening—even without bacteria. The food self-destructs.

twist.text: Oxidation turns fats rancid and vitamins inactive. Oxygen is as much an enemy of food as bacteria are.

climax.text: Every preservation method targets at least one of these enemies. Most effective methods target several simultaneously.

punchline.text: Food has five enemies. Master them all and food lasts decades.

quiz.question: Besides microbes, what is a major cause of food spoilage?
